summary: Explains the shuffle filter for randomizing list order, seeding it for idempotent order, and that it does nothing on non-list items.
questions: How do I shuffle a list in Ansible?
How do I get a consistent random order per host?

answer_card.title: Shuffling a list
answer_card.answer_md:
```jinja
{{ ['a','b','c'] | shuffle }}
{{ ['a','b','c'] | shuffle(seed=inventory_hostname) }}  # stable order
```

On a non-list value, `shuffle` does nothing.
